title: 1. Send one message to many
subtitle: One approved template, many contacts
narration: A broadcast sends one approved WhatsApp template to many contacts at once. Before you start, make sure a WhatsApp Business number is connected through Meta, your template is approved, and your Eazybe wallet has balance.

title: 2. Start a new broadcast
subtitle: Broadcasts → New broadcast
narration: From the Broadcasts page, click New broadcast in the top right corner. Eazybe opens the Create broadcast page, where you'll set everything up in three quick steps.

title: 3. Choose the message
subtitle: Name · Send from · Template · Preview
narration: First, give your broadcast a name — only your team sees it. Pick the number to send from, choose an approved template, and check the Message preview on the right to see exactly what recipients will get.

title: 4. Choose the recipients
subtitle: Upload a list · HubSpot contact list
narration: Next, choose who receives it. Upload a CSV or Excel list, or switch to the HubSpot contact list tab to pick a synced list — duplicate phone numbers are removed automatically.

title: 5. Review and send
subtitle: Recipients · Estimated cost · Send broadcast
narration: Select your contacts, then check the footer: it shows the recipient count, the sending number, the template, and the Estimated cost. When everything looks right, click Send broadcast — sending uses wallet balance, and you can't recall a campaign once it's out.

title: 6. Track the results
subtitle: Back to Broadcasts → View Analytics
narration: And that's it — your campaign is on its way. Head back to the Broadcasts page to watch delivery, and click View Analytics for recipient-level results.
